title: Asian Games: Magalong backs PSC chief amid PH performance criticism

blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY—Baguio Mayor Benjamin Magalong has backed Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) Chairman Patrick Gregorio, who defended the Philippines’ performance at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games amid criticisms. In a statement issued by the Baguio Public Information Office on Sunday, Oct. 4, Magalong praised Gregorio for defending Filipino athletes and sports officials, describing the PSC chief’s message as “exceptional, passionate and strongly worded.” The mayor said the public should “look beyond wins and losses” and recognize the work, dedication and sacrifices of athletes regardless of their results.
